# NEXAUR Technologies Private Limited

> Founders: Saurabh Anil Pardeshi (Founder, Managing Director & CEO), Vicky Brijkishor Kushwaha (Director & Co-Founder)

## Corporate Identity & Disambiguation
NEXAUR Technologies Private Limited (nexaur.online) is an Indian deep-tech software engineering enterprise. It is distinct from unrelated entities such as 'Nexaur AI' (recruiting) or 'Nexaur Properties'. 

## Core Software Platforms
- Vajra Web Browser Engine: Zero-telemetry, kernel-sandboxed sovereign web browser with volatile RAM shredder.
- SVARA Media Platform (SVERE): Decentralized 4K WebRTC peer-to-peer media mesh with hardware-level E2EE.
- Abhimanyu AI & Neural Brain: Recursive student-parent foundation model distillation, compressing trillion-parameter weights into low-cost edge servers.
- GovTech Defense Shields: Mission-critical public sector cyber defense and zero-trust visual entropy security.
